question: Without changing or relaxing a promotion gate post hoc, what is the exact full-shape error distribution introduced by the two-chain FP reassociation, and what is its exact-shape timing effect?

implementation.diagnostic_change: Remove the v12 assertion only after preserving its terminal rejection; report exactness plus maximum, median, and p99 scaled error across all 34,816 outputs, then run the already frozen 9-repetition timing.

decision_contract.next_if_speed_is_material_and_errors_are: Freeze a separate 27B model-level experiment using CUTE-20, MMLU-64, WikiText, MATH, and paired throughput.
decision_contract.next_otherwise: Reject dual-chain reassociation and redesign the CQ3 integer microkernel without changing FP reduction order.

stop_rules: Stop if any error statistic is non-finite or any receipt denominator differs.
Do not promote v13 regardless of timing.
Do not run model quality from v13 without a new preregistration.
Do not convert partial or failed measurements into a score.
claim_boundary: v13 can characterize one CQ3 AVX2 schedule on one exact Qwen3.8-27B MLP shape. It cannot establish an acceptable numerical bound, model quality, a production kernel, whole-model speed, 100 accepted tok/s, novelty, or a breakthrough.
